source_geometry_self_consistency.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

agent_assumptions: North=plan top, South=plan bottom, West=plan left, East=plan right, confirmed by matching dimension chains across all 4 elevations and the plan.
Exact interior door positions along corridor walls approximated at room-segment midpoints from visible arcs; not pixel-precise.
Wall thickness taken as nominal 240mm per plan label, not explicitly modeled as offset per wall (representative centerline geometry used).
Corridor modeled as one L-shaped polygon absorbing a jog area near the East wall that contains a secondary exterior door.
Window/door head heights inferred from elevation sill/height dimensions (1000mm sill+1800mm or 2400mm height); exact per-window variation not fully verified.
Single floor building (only 1F plan supplied); elevations show only ground floor height (4.5m) so treated as single storey.

REVISION: East_view.png bottom dimension chain (5700,1600,1540,4800,740,1200,2380,1500,540=20000mm, South to North) shows the East double-door (1600mm) spans y=[5.7,7.3]m, not fitting inside the previously modeled corridor jog (y up to 6.66m only). The corridor jog / MeetingRoomBig shared boundary is moved from y=6.66 to y=7.3 so the full door width is hosted on the corridor's east exterior wall, matching elevation evidence exactly (this also matches the East elevation's 1540 solid-wall segment directly above the door, from y=7.3 to 8.84, below the MeetingRoomBig window).
unresolved: Exact interior door swing directions and leaf widths not verified pixel-by-pixel.
Precise partition wall thicknesses/offsets not surveyed via check_wall_dimensions due to time budget (representative centerline geometry used throughout; offsets_m unknown).

Whether the East jog area near the corrected door is a real vestibule/closet or purely corridor widening remains a labeling question only; its physical extent is now aligned to the 1600mm door span from East_view.png.
South/East/West window sill and head heights assumed from representative elevation reading; not cross-checked per-window beyond span matching.
North elevation door/window head heights (2.6m door, 3.4m window) not independently re-verified in this revision pass; carried over from seed.
